concept.title: Remote Smart Parking Assist malfunction and limitations

keywords.indexterm: remote smart parking assist (RSPA) malfunction and limitations

li.p: The following warning message will appear on the LCD display.
For more details, refer to the malfunction and limitations section of the function.
Check Parking Assist Visit A Nearby Service Center.
Parking Assist Canceled. Please Refer To Owner’s Manual.
Parking Assist Conditions Not Met Please Refer To Owner’s Manual.
